exactArguments.prompt:
Use case: illustration-story.
Asset type: one complete literary 2D room-and-character mother candidate for Zaichang, landscape, matching the supplied room canvas.

The ONLY supplied image is a clean EMPTY room. Use it only as the room/camera/furniture/lighting reference. Keep the same complete window, lakeside view, left desk and shelves, small lamp table, long upholstered wooden window seat, cushions, blanket, floor and perspective. Keep the same framing and full-room warm clear-day light; do not zoom, redesign the room, add panels, or collage. Create the entire person freshly from the following words. No earlier character image or screenshot is an input.

Draw Umiri Yahata / 八幡海铃 from Ave Mujica as the recognizable high-school girl she is, seated naturally near the right end of the existing window-seat cushion, with her entire head, body, hands, both knees, lower legs and complete boots inside the frame at a believable scale in this room. The picture is a quiet literary anime illustration: delicate, varied hand-drawn 2D lines, soft painted planes, air and wood light shared by girl and room. Her youth and intelligence coexist. Do not render her as a realistic adult fashion model or a childlike doll.

This small moment: she has been finishing one sentence in her own small dark notebook laid open across her lap. A familiar person just speaks from nearby at the left side of the picture, outside the frame. Her eyes have lifted to that person before the notebook has been put away. Her left hand still holds the notebook safely at its bottom/page edge, her right hand still loosely holds a short pencil whose tip has paused against the page margin. Both hands have real, readable contact with book and pencil. She does not offer advice or point into blank air. The slight interest is hers: a clear, quietly questioning look and the smallest unequal hint at one mouth corner, as if she has actually heard something worth answering. No broad welcoming smile, sadness, flirtatious posing, or performed nurturing.

Her recognizable hair is short-to-medium charcoal gray-black, a layered bob reaching around the neck/shoulder tops, with directional side-swept bangs, small separated side locks and gently outward-turning ends. It stays a layered bob, not long wavy hair, not abundant black curls. Her eyes are clear pale blue-gray / cool gray-cyan, normally open with visible irises and alert focus, restrained upper-lid lines and fine natural lower lids. Preserve her calm directness; do not use sleepy half-closed narrow eyes, heavy eyeliner, dark glamorous lashes or a sultry look. Her face has natural soft teenage cheeks and a compact, light jaw ending in a short unforced chin, with a small lightly drawn nose and fine simple mouth. Keep natural teenage facial proportions: not enlarged glassy circular eyes, not a baby round face, not a long tapering adult lower face. No cosmetic lip volume or realistic nose ridge. Head approximately upright with only a tiny natural turn toward the person, chin level; neck and shoulders relaxed, without the habitual diagonal head tilt and model smile.

Chosen complete outfit: her punk daily outfit, freshly illustrated in this light: a short matte black leather biker jacket with believable lapels, zipper, small metal snaps and soft folds at shoulder/elbow/waist; a muted dark-red short top with a restrained V neckline, gray high-waisted short pleated skirt, simple black belt, thin black choker and small subtle earrings. Bare lower legs. Black mid-calf lace-up boots with substantial chunky platform soles and modest block heels, complete boot shafts/laces/soles visible. Do not replace it with a school uniform, add long socks, fashion stilettos or over-knee boots. Clothing must not be sexualized.

Build the entire seated figure with this exact room at once. Her hips and weight settle into the existing soft cushion, skirt folds and a modest cushion compression/contact shadow explain the seat. Shoulders, torso and hips belong to one relaxed seated body, not a separate pasted portrait. The notebook is really supported by thighs and hand. Design two natural, anatomically continuous legs from each hip through its own knee and ankle into its own boot, with clear plausible overlap; no knee-on-knee cross-leg pose is required. Let gravity, the bench height and this sitting posture determine whether a sole touches the floor or a boot hangs slightly: there is no requirement that both feet touch. Make the support and perspective convincing, and keep complete boots visible. Warm window light and soft room bounce must fall continuously on hair, skin, jacket, notebook, cushion and wood, with fine contact shadows.

Keep the left part of the clean room intact for actual future product content; do not paint a blank white/gray overlay, text, UI, buttons, labels, logos, speech bubbles, borders, watermark or extra people. One integrated full mother illustration, not a character sheet, montage, split panel, cutout or mask.
